name: Paddle
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Paddle, build a product catalog and entitlement layer around a normal payment provider. The hard boundary is merchant-of-record tax, billing, fraud, subscriptions, global payments, and compliance, plus payments, tax, distribution, and operations.
